$schema_note: The backtest corpus. This file is the DENOMINATOR of the headline metric,
so every count here is verified against the State Water Board's own index
Two-tier honesty on every record. `index_verified` means the document's
existence, number and URL were read off the Board's index page.
`document_read` means the PDF itself has been parsed and its action verb,
priority cutoff and gage trigger extracted. A record can be index-verified
and not document-read, and the backtest must never score a record whose
expected action came from anywhere but the document itself.

addenda.title: Addendum 3: Update to Scott River Surface Water Curtailments for Farmer's Ditch Company
addenda.transcription_note: No text layer; pdftotext returns 5 bytes. Read from the rendered pages. Verbatim: 'this Addendum 3 provides for the limited, conditional suspension of curtailment for Farmer's Ditch Company, under the conditions noted below.' Conditions: 'Limit diversions to the lesser of: (1) 7 cfs (the amount identified in its request); or (2) excess water in the Scott River watershed, which is defined as the instantaneous flow at the USGS Fort Jones gage that exceeds the minimum flow requirement of 33 cfs for September.' Expiry: 'This addendum expires at 11:59 pm on September 30, 2024, unless amended or superseded prior to that date.'

addenda.title: Addendum 4: Update to Scott River Surface Water Curtailments for Farmer's Ditch Company and Scott Valley Irrigation District
addenda.transcription_note: No text layer; pdftotext returns 4 bytes. Read from the rendered pages. Verbatim: 'Based on consideration of the current flow and generally stable flows of between 44 to 46 cubic feet per second (cfs) during the last week at the ... Fort Jones gage ... this Addendum provides for the limited, conditional suspension of curtailment for Farmer's Ditch Company and Scott Valley Irrigation District.' Caps: 'For Farmers Ditch Company: 7 cfs ... and for Scott Valley Irrigation District: 7.5 cfs under its right described in Schedule D3 in the Scott River Adjudication.' Expiry: 'This addendum expires at 11:59 pm on Monday, September 30, 2024, unless amended or superseded prior to that date.'

addenda.data_quality_note: TITLE UNDERSTATES THE ACT. The parser classifies this as 'amend' from its title, 'Update to Scott River Surface Water Curtailments for Farmer's Ditch Company and Scott Valley Irrigation District'. The body authorises diversion under conditions, which is functionally a limited conditional suspension scoped to named diverters, and it sets DIFFERENT dispositions for the two: Farmer's Ditch may divert immediately, Scott Valley Irrigation District only 'after additional written approval from the State Water Board'. The body never says of itself that it is a suspension, so the title/body conflict detector correctly does not fire. Recorded here rather than auto-resolved. October minimum stated as 40 cfs. Expires 2024-10-31.

OPEN 2026-08-10: two documents resist classification for stated reasons. Scott 2021 Addendum 23 has a CORRUPTED HEADER text layer: the subject line decodes only under a +29 character shift ('6FRWW5LYHU' is 'Scott River'), and the body never restates the act self-referentially. Measured, the document is NOT wholly mojibake: 20.4 percent of its words are recognisable against 20.7 percent for a known-good sibling, so a garbage-text heuristic would not catch it. The decoded header reads 'Scott River Temporary Extension of Conditional Suspension of Curtailments'. Shasta 2021 order WR 2022-0161-DWR is a COVER LETTER describing an enclosed order in the third person ('The enclosed Order curtails certain surface water and groundwater diversions'), so its own action is transmittal, not curtailment.

RESOLVED 2026-08-10: the four records that carried a note instead of a URL are resolved. Their filenames carry no number (scott-curtailment-suspension, scott-more-suspensions, addendum-two-to-order-... spelling the number out, shasta-more-suspensions), which is exactly what the plan predicted would defeat a filename-based mapping. Each number was then CONFIRMED FROM THE DOCUMENT'S OWN TEXT rather than from its position on the index page, because page order is an inference and the title is evidence.

extraction_status.note: The denominator of the headline metric is the scorable count, not the declared total. 102 is the number of documents the Board's index pages show exist. Only 33 are individually enumerated here: the 2021 series carry addenda counts of 51 and 16 without per-document entries, because those index pages publish no per-addendum URLs. Of the 24 PDFs fetched, 4 have no text layer at all and are refused rather than guessed. Any claim of the form 'N of M' must use the scorable count as M.
extraction_status.stray_file_note: Files on disk exceed fetched records because three documents were downloaded by hand early on, before the fetcher existed, under names that do not follow the record key scheme: addendum6-shasta-attach-a, addendum8-scottriver-7-22-2025, order-wr-0005-dwr-scott-sws-curtailment. They are duplicates of records already counted, so counting them as fetched would have inflated the numerator. The manifest guard caught this when pdfs_fetched exceeded the enumerated record count.
